notes_for_editor: Single-source story: the Alberta register supports the build year, size, location and active status. Two searches for a Wadlin lookout history, and one for Wadlin Lake, found nothing linking a tower to the lake or to earlier years, so none is used. A 2009 Alberta lookout map text cached locally (data/raw/expansion/prairies-north/ab_lookout_map_2009.txt, no source URL known) lists WADLIN. If that map is right, a site of that name predates the 2015 build year; the editor should find its URL before citing it. The brief record's access 'closed' and staffing note ('staffed March-October') are not traced to any source I could read, so the story uses the register's drive-access flag instead.
